summary: Copa Holdings, S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, announcing only the scheduling of its third-quarter 2026 earnings release for November 18, 2026, after the US market close, and a related conference call and webcast on November 19, 2026, at 11:00 AM US ET. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation, so there is no deal or risk-arbitrage angle to monitor beyond normal quarterly results and guidance.
